# seedgx

seedgx checks seed declarations, not runtime reproducibility: missing seeds,
duplicate seeds, out-of-range values. Part of gxkit; the inspect contract (stable
codes, exit codes, a storyboard) is shared.

- Install/run: uvx --from "git+https://github.com/nekomario28/gxkit#subdirectory=packages/seedgx" seedgx inspect seed.py
- Write: a Python file building seedgx.SeedSpec(streams=[seedgx.Stream("python", 42), seedgx.Stream("numpy", 7)]); or STREAMS / DETERMINISTIC / NAME.
- A stream is Stream(name, seed). Seeds are integers (not floats or booleans): 0..4294967295.
- seedgx inspect seed.py — exit 1 on any error; --json; --no-storyboard; -o name.png.
- Codes: invalid-seed (error), missing-seed (error), seed-out-of-range (error), duplicate-stream (error), duplicate-seed (warn), non-deterministic (info), no-streams (info).
